content.value: An under damped harmonic oscillator has its amplitude reduced $\frac { 1 } { 2 0 } t h$ of its
initial value after 200 oscillations. Its time period is 1.30 sec.
(i) Calculate the damping constant and relaxation time.
(ii) If the observed value of the first amplitude of the oscillator were 2.2 cm, what would be its value in the absence of damping?
